display.title: Kill the Scylla
display.subtitle: Boss kill
description: Scylla is the sea boss of the Acropolis, a structure that generates in warm ocean. Her allies guard it.
An Eye of Storm, used like an Eye of Ender, points to the Acropolis. Water breathing is very handy.
The kill itself is tracked once, in the Bosses chapter. This quest completes after that one; just tick it off.
